text.en: Analysis with gpt-3 is row 75 of the BenchCouncil AI100 (2022-2023) annual table in the Evaluation Analysis area.
text.zh: Analysis with gpt-3 是 BenchCouncil AI100（2022-2023）年度表第 75 行，所属领域为“评测与分析”。

text.en: The annual table associates Analysis with gpt-3 with “What Makes Good In-Context Examples for GPT-3?”.
text.zh: 年度表把 Analysis with gpt-3 与论文《What Makes Good In-Context Examples for GPT-3?》关联。

text.en: The Main Contributors field is “Jiachang Liu, Weizhu Chen”.
text.zh: “主要人物”字段依次列出 Jiachang Liu（官方页拼写）、Weizhu Chen（官方页拼写）；官方英文原文为“Jiachang Liu, Weizhu Chen”。
